title: The Frog on the Sock
sentences: Jo and Skip sat on a rug in the grass.
A hat and a snack sat on the rug.
A frog came from the grass.
Skip went to get the hat.
The frog did a hop and sat on the sock.
Skip sat still, and Jo gave a grin.
The frog did a hop back to the grass.
Skip got the hat, and they had the snack.

comprehensionQuestion.question: What did Skip do while the frog sat on his sock?
answers: He put on the black hat.
